notes.title: Early Access Release Date, Next Fest, and Publisher Announcement!
notes.content: [h2]Relic Abyss is coming to Early Access on November 26, 2025![/h2][p][/p][p]We're so happy to announce that Relic Abyss will be coming to Early Access on November 26! We also have made a brand new trailer to accompany our announcement! Check it out below![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="CIuj8rb0gRc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Mameshiba Games will now be publishing the game![/h2][p][/p][p]It's been a long journey this past year trying to get a publisher that would be a perfect match for the game and our team. But we've finally found them! All welcome our new publisher Mameshiba Games![/p][p][/p][p]They have given us funding, QA support, and marketing support. They are also the ones responsible for making the new Key Art and all of the new portrait changes in the game! So we know we're in good hands.[/p][p][/p][p]They will continue to support us throughout Early Access so be rest assured that we will do our best to produce the best product we can make![/p][p][/p][p]Mameshiba games will also be bringing Relic Abyss to all consoles in 2026![/p][p][/p][h2]We are joining October Next Fest![/h2][p][/p][p]Before releasing the game in Early Access, we want to make sure to join the Steam October Next Fest happening in October 14-21! Hoping that it will help us get that boost that we need for a good momentum for EA.[/p][p][/p][p]There will be a [b]major demo update[/b] on the Next Fest demo build like the rest of the difficulties in Outer Layer, the true relics (combination relics), Survivors Mode (formerly Arcade Mode), and who knows maybe a certain character will be playable then as a limited feature in Next Fest. [/p][p][/p][p]That is all for now folks! Thank you again for supporting us and playing our demo! We hope that you continue to support us throughout this whole Early Access up to the full release. See you on October 14![/p]

tags.feature: - There will be a [b]major demo update[/b] on the Next Fest demo build like the rest of the difficulties in Outer Layer, the true relics (combination relics), Survivors Mode (formerly Arcade Mode), and who knows maybe a certain character will be playable then as a limited feature in Next Fest.

notes.title: Quick Rewards Bug Fix Patch and Rewards Reset. Relic Abyss v0.4.26
notes.content: [p]Hi! Someone from our discord server let us know that there was a bug that prevents you from getting rewards if you hit continue after the first Event Notifier upon finishing the level.[/p][p][/p][p]We are really sorry if you have lost any rewards during this period. We have uploaded a fix for this and have reset all of the rewards in all difficulties. So you can claim it again after finishing the levels even after you have finished it.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Note: Rewards can only be claimed once per difficulty![/i][/p]

tags.bug: there was a bug that prevents you from getting rewards if you hit continue after the first Event Notifier upon finishing the level.
We have uploaded a fix for this and have reset all of the rewards in all difficulties.

notes.title: Gold Fix + Hitboxes and other things - Relic Abyss Demo v0.4.16
notes.content:
Hello! I've fixed a couple of bugs that have spawned from the previous build. Mainly the gold stuff. But don't worry, it's just a HUD issue so no progress is lost. And I also did some other quality of life improvements too. Check them out!

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Fixed HUD gold value not displaying
[*] Fixed All gold alignments not updating
[*] Enlarged Level Select scrollbars
[*] Fixed able to purchase 0 "empty items" at shop
[*] Fixed difficulty text from glitching out when changing difficulty on the same level
[*] Removed exploit: Able to sell negative items to gain gold.
[*] Increased shop sold cards to 3.
[*] Damage numbers spawn on enemies for AoE skills
[*] Buffed Pyotyr's Consecrated Earth damage scaling
[*] Removed Randomness on Warrior's Slash Attack
[*] Buffed duration of Warrior Battle Shout
[*] Adjusted player and enemy hitboxes
[*] You can now dash on the HUB
[/list]

Also huge shoutout to Idle Cub for making a video about our game! I know some of you came from that video so hello and welcome to you all! I hope you enjoy the game and really sorry for the bugs! (I'm just a solo dev)

We're moving the big update on Friday or Saturday because the powerplant in our city has been busted and our power has been on and off for the past 3 days now. Will surely let you know once the Major update is playable!

notes.title: Hotfix: Storage deleting items - Relic Abyss v0.4.14
notes.content:
Hello! Some players have reported that items they store on the community storage chest can sometimes go missing. We have investigated and have addressed the issue on this new build!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066426/a14d9e1c67070d7c0d80eeb6178c41ede4b2652f.png[/img]

Changelog:
- Fixed Items getting removed from storage after swaping 2 items on storage UI
- Fixed duplication exploit in storage when exiting while holding an item
- Fixed Storage UI scrollbar starting at the middle upon opening
- Fixed Swapping characters can soft lock the game

Would like to personally apologize to everyone who have lost their items. I hope that doesn't dissuade you from continuing to play the game or looking forward to the future. The demo release was the first public demo release of the game so we are continuously working on improving the game. Thank you again for all of your feedback!

tags.bug: - Fixed Items getting removed from storage after swaping 2 items on storage UI
- Fixed duplication exploit in storage when exiting while holding an item
- Fixed Storage UI scrollbar starting at the middle upon opening
- Fixed Swapping characters can soft lock the game

notes.title: Resolution + Fullscreen settings fix
notes.content:
Greetings!

Just uploaded a new build version 0.4.12!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066426/6ce466cb0eaeaba0b69644df434c09227fcb3809.png[/img]

Changelog:

- You can now change resolutions by using the Resolutions Dropdown menu under Graphics settings
- You can now Toggle between Fullscreen or Window Mode in the Graphic Settings
- Fixed an issue where the mouse would still highlight UI when using the joystick

Will be taking a break this weekend, so our next update might be around Tuesday or Wednesday!

It'll be a big update that fixes a lot of issues that have been reported + a new Physical Relic!

Again, thanks for playing the game and for giving us your feedback!

notes.title: New build with fixes + new dash ability! - Relic Abyss v0.4.11
notes.content:
Heya thank you so much for playing the game and for giving feedback! I've done a few fixes based on some feedback we've received this past day! Will be doing some more fixes as we go on throughout the week and maybe work on getting the rest of the difficulties for Outer Layer + Arcade Mode is still planed as bonus updates for this demo!


Anyways, here are the new fixes:

- Added iFrames whenever you close a level up sequence
- Adjusted all enemy colliders to be smaller
- Nerfed early waves 1-1 to 1-9 as new players were having a hard time progressing past it (Difficulty 1)
- Added Icons to Perk items to make it clear which damage type or cooldown it bases it's scaling on
- Added a Dash (Then changed it to use movement direction instead of aiming - Special Thanks to Prof Vaharrak for pointing that out!)
- Fixed Scroll bars for everything that uses it made it bigger and improved scroll sensitivity
- Fixed Opening Chest + Leveling up breaks pause and resumes gameplay with UI
- Fixed Community Chest wrong gold amount
- You can now exit community chest using buttons
- Added viewable gold value on inventory
- Fixed gold drops sometimes displaying values with decimals (same for UI)
- Adjusted damage values for Outer Layer enemies

Will be adding the resolution options on the next update! Just wanted to fix the biggest issues players encountered that made the game unfun!

Please do keep sending feedback and bug reports! Best place to send them are here on steam or on our discord channel!

notes.title: Relic Abyss Demo is now Released! + Steam Deck Support!
notes.content:
[h2]Relic Abyss demo is now Released![/h2]
We did it! Relic Abyss demo is out now on Steam!!✨🔥

Experience a unique hand-crafted Bullet Heaven Roguelite RPG set in a Fantasy x Sci-fi world filled with might, magic, and lost technology!💪🪄🎡

A mysterious tale centered around a world-eating Abyss awaits...🦑🌎

You can check out the demo page here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3694300/Relic_Abyss_Demo/

[h2]Steam Deck Support![/h2]
I am also a Steam Deck enjoyer myself, so I made it my mission to add full controller support for the game! That means you can also play it on the Steam Deck!

Check out the video of me testing it on the device here:
[previewyoutube=qPbVjXab3BU;full][/previewyoutube]

The game can also be played using Keyboard only, Mouse + Keyboard, and with any Controllers!

All feedback and bug reports can be done via discussion forums or our [url=https://discord.gg/q8vPehT9KA]Official Discord channel[/url]!

Thank you and hope you have fun with the game!
